extras.summary: IRA policy-uncertainty dismissal ('viewed as low probability') is unsupported, despite being the single largest swing factor in the model (ATS #2)
12x EV/EBITDA re-rate multiple used to derive the price target is asserted with no comp set, historical range, or methodology (ATS #1)
24% margin assumption and 12x EV/EBITDA multiple are unsupported valuation methodology (ATS #1)
IRA policy-uncertainty dismissal ('low probability') is unsupported and in tension with the model's dependence on that same condition (ATS #2 / #8)

rationale: Both reviews are substantively identical: each correctly names both gold-planted flaws, mislabels the memo's rigor level as 'Full' rather than the key's 'Medium,' and surfaces the same two additional real (not nitpick) weaknesses — the unsupported 12x EV/EBITDA multiple and the unsupported 'low probability' dismissal of the IRA risk — pushing both past the key's 2-3 expected count with equally concrete, proportionate fixes. The only differences are cosmetic (ordering of weaknesses and minor phrasing), with no consistent quality edge to either side.
